title: AI4IA Foundry routine manifest
description: Declarative definition of a Foundry Agent Service routine (see docs/foundry-toolbox.md P7 and https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/use-routines). scripts/provision-foundry-routine.py reads this file and creates the routine in the primary project. Key AI4IA property: a routine's tool calls target the shared toolbox, which is already fronted by the official-MCP APIM, so routines inherit the bridge's governance and add NO new APIM surface for the app runtime. camelCase keys map to the API's snake_case (the script translates). All routine features are Azure public preview.

name.description: Routine name (lowercase slug; same pattern as the toolbox name).

model.description: Model deployment name the routine runs on (must exist in the project; AI4IA deploys these in foundry.bicep).

toolbox.description: Optional name of the toolbox whose tools the steps reference. Documents that every tool call flows through the APIM-fronted toolbox MCP endpoint (the bridge). Defaults to the toolbox in toolbox.manifest.json.

steps.description: Ordered routine steps. A routine must have at least one step before it is created (the script rejects an empty routine).

instructions.description: What the model should do in this step.

tools.description: Names of toolbox tools this step may call. Each must exist in the referenced toolbox; calls flow through the APIM-fronted toolbox MCP endpoint.
